messages:
rachel: FYI I opened a PR to correct Nectar5B model card facts: max sequence lengths for the light and pro variants, improve the bench table (separate fp16/int8 rows), and add a short migration note for customers moving from runtime v2.x to v3.x. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5032 :sparkles:

omar: can you call out which variant supports embedding sharding? the previous card implied both did but the compact-int8 variant fails the merge test. :thinking:

rachel: good catch. updated supported-variants section: nectar5b-pro (fp16) = shardable, nectar5b-compact-int8 = non-shardable (merging can corrupt alignments). added a short rationale and a link to embedding-sharding troubleshooting.

tia: for benches, customers want the GPU column and the raw bench command. please split bench rows by variant and quantization and include the exact command line we ran.
rachel: added GPU column and bench command (A100-40GB, pinned-seqlen, perf-script.sh --variant=pro --seq=8192 --bs=1). also noted that 32k/64k long-context runs used pinned-seqlen + cache-resize.

qa-lin: add eval checklist before merge: reproduce fp16 and int8 benches, run tokenization diff on 50 lang+code prompts, and run embedding-shard idempotency test for the shardable variant. I'll queue the runs after merge if needed, but prefer to verify pre-merge. ETA ~5h.

omar: small SDK request  include a minimal Go example showing how to set fallback to cpu for the compact-int8 case (so users get graceful degradation). keeps example short.
rachel: adding Go snippet: 

```go
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
)
func main() {
  client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY")
  resp, _ := client.Generate(redwood.GenerateParams{
    Model: "nectar5b-compact-int8",
    Input: "Summarize quarterly revenue",
    Stream: true,
    Fallback: redwood.Fallback{Mode: "cpu"},
  })
  for chunk := range resp.Stream() {
    fmt.Print(chunk.Text)
  }
}
```

tia: nit  change the model string to "nectar5b-compact-int8 (non-shardable)" only in the prose; keep code model param unchanged. also link to runtime compatibility section about cpu fallback.
rachel: done. replaced the old runtime link (broken) with https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/compatibility#fallbacks and fixed other stale links.

lint-bot: lint report: models/nectar5b.md  headings OK, found one markdown-link warning (line 58) and a trailing whitespace on line 120.
rachel: fixed the link and trimmed whitespace. assigning reviewers @omar @tia @qa-lin. target to merge by EOD to get into the next catalog push. :calendar:

omar: I'll review the bench commands and the Go snippet tomorrow morning.

qa-lin: queuing the eval runs now; will post results in this thread (expect ~4.5h). if shard idempotency fails we'll block and file a follow-up doc + infra ticket.
rachel: thanks all  tagging product so they know the variant change (non-shardable flag) hits the customer-facing catalog. :white_check_mark:
